records.jp: 何よ、叫んじゃって。意味わかんない
records.en_original: Don't scream at me. What's your problem?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't scream at me. What's your problem?
records.en: Why are you shouting? I don't get you.

records.jp: 悪いのはあんたじゃない！
records.en_original: You're the one who's manipulating people!
records.en_auxiliary: You're the one who's manipulating people!
records.en: You're the one in the wrong!

records.jp: ……ねえ、日菜子ちゃん。私が悪いの、かな
records.en_original: ...Hey, Hinako. Am I the one in the wrong here?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hey, Hinako. Am I the one in the wrong here?
records.en: ...Hey, Hinako-chan. Am I the one in the wrong here?

records.jp: どうしてそう思うの？
records.en_original: Why do you think that?
records.en_auxiliary: Why do you think that?
records.en: Why do you think that?

records.jp: 友達の好きな人までとった……わけじゃないけど、<CR>振り向かせちゃったことがあってさ
records.en_original: Well, I... It's not that I took the guy my friend liked, but I think I might have gotten him interested in me.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I... It's not that I took the guy my friend liked, but I think I might have gotten him interested in me.
records.en: It's not like I stole the guy my friend liked,<CR>but I did make him notice me.

records.jp: もちろん私にはそんな気はなかったし、丁重にお断りしたよ？<CR>でも……
records.en_original: I really didn't mean to do it, and I turned him down flat, <CR>but...
records.en_auxiliary: I really didn't mean to do it, and I turned him down flat, but...
records.en: Of course I didn't mean to do that, and I politely turned him down.<CR>But...

records.jp: 私が努力すればするほど、キレイになろうとすればするほど、<CR>誰かを不幸にしてる気がするんだもん
records.en_original: It feels like the more beautiful I try to make myself, the more misfortune I bring onto others.
records.en_auxiliary: It feels like the more beautiful I try to make myself, the more misfortune I bring onto others.
records.en: The harder I try, the more beautiful I become,<CR>the more it feels like I'm making someone unhappy.

records.jp: 自意識過剰？
records.en_original: You're probably imagining things.
records.en_auxiliary: You're probably imagining things.
records.en: Maybe you're being too self-conscious?

records.jp: こら、ライム、口挟まない
records.en_original: Not helpful, Lime!
records.en_auxiliary: Not helpful, Lime!
records.en: Hey, Lime, don't interrupt.

records.jp: 私が媚びてないって思ってるだけで、<CR>周りからは媚びてるように見えてるのかな？
records.en_original: Even though I don't think I'm trying to flirt with anyone, <CR>it seems like others see it that way.
records.en_auxiliary: Even though I don't think I'm trying to flirt with anyone,<CR>it seems like others see it that way.
records.en: Maybe I only think I'm not flirting,<CR>but everyone else sees it that way?

records.jp: それとも私、本当は媚びていたのかな？
records.en_original: ...Or maybe I really AM flirting with them.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Or maybe I really AM flirting with them.
records.en: Or maybe I really was flirting with them?

records.jp: わかんなく、なってきちゃった……
records.en_original: It's like I don't even know myself anymore...
records.en_auxiliary: It's like I don't even know myself anymore...
records.en: I don't know what to think anymore...

records.jp: ……私は違うと思うな
records.en_original: ...I don't think that's it.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I don't think that's it.
records.en: ...I don't think that's it.

records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 誰かに媚びるためだったら、あんなに<CR>真っ直ぐな目はできないかなって
records.en_original: If you were just trying to make people like you, I don't think you'd be as honest as you are.
records.en_auxiliary: If you were just trying to make people like you, I don't think you'd be as honest as you are.
records.en: If you were doing it just to flirt with someone,<CR>you couldn't have that honest look in your eyes.

records.jp: きっとしほりは、一生懸命なだけなんだよ
records.en_original: Beause, Shihori, you put your heart into everything you do.
records.en_auxiliary: Because, Shihori, you put your heart into everything you do.
records.en: I think you're just doing your best, Shihori.

records.jp: キレイになることに、周りの人たちをキレイにすることに<CR>一生懸命すぎて、誤解されてるだけなんだと思う
records.en_original: You put your heart into making yourself and the people around you more beautiful. They just misunderstand you.
records.en_auxiliary: You put your heart into making yourself and the people around you more beautiful. They just misunderstand you.
records.en: I think you care so much about making yourself and others beautiful<CR>that people end up misunderstanding you.

records.jp: そこまで「キレイ」が好きなのに、<CR>媚びるためなんて、自分の努力を否定するのはだめだよ
records.en_original: Don't let their misunderstanding steal your love of beauty away. You've put too much love into it for that.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't let their misunderstanding steal your love of beauty away. You've put too much love into it for that.
records.en: You love beauty that much.<CR>Don't deny all your hard work by telling yourself it was just to flirt.

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん……
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako-chan...

records.jp: ……ありがとう。<CR>そう言ってくれると、ちょっとだけ楽になれたかも
records.en_original: ...Thank you. When you put it like that, I really do feel better.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you. When you put it like that, I really do feel better.
records.en: ...Thank you.<CR>Hearing you say that makes me feel a little better.

records.jp: 私、みんながキレイになるのが嬉しくて
records.en_original: I want everyone to be the prettiest they can be.
records.en_auxiliary: I want everyone to be the prettiest they can be.
records.en: It makes me happy to see everyone become beautiful.

records.jp: みんながキレイになりたいって、<CR>相談してくれるのが嬉しくて……
records.en_original: And I want to help make that happen.
records.en_auxiliary: And I want to help make that happen.
records.en: It makes me happy when people come to me for advice<CR>because they want to become beautiful...

records.jp: みんなでキレイになりたいって
records.en_original: Because together, we can become more beautiful than we ever could on our own.
records.en_auxiliary: Because together, we can become more beautiful than we ever could on our own.
records.en: I wanted us all to become beautiful together.

records.jp: ……ずっとそう思ってた
records.en_original: ...I believe that from the bottom of my heart.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I believe that from the bottom of my heart.
records.en: ...That's what I've always thought.

records.jp: 面倒見がよくて純粋ってことだよねっ
records.en_original: That's because you're a caring and genuine person.
records.en_auxiliary: That's because you're a caring and genuine person.
records.en: That just means you're caring and sincere!

records.jp: そ、そこまで言われるのはちょっと照れるけど
records.en_original: O-Okay, all of this is getting a little embarassing now...
records.en_auxiliary: O-okay, all of this is getting a little embarrassing now...
records.en: I-It's a little embarrassing to hear you say that much...

records.jp: でも……ありがとう、日菜子ちゃん。<CR>おかげで私らしさに自信を持てそうだよ
records.en_original: But... Thank you, Hinako. You've given me so much more faith in who I am.
records.en_auxiliary: But... Thank you, Hinako. You've given me so much more faith in who I am.
records.en: But...thank you, Hinako-chan.<CR>Thanks to you, I think I can feel confident being myself.

records.jp: よかった……
records.en_original: I'm glad to hear it.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad to hear it.
records.en: I'm glad to hear it.

records.jp: それで、どうするの？　あの子のこと
records.en_original: So, what are you going to do about that girl?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what are you going to do about that girl?
records.en: So, what are you going to do about that girl?

records.jp: ……どうなるかはわからないけど、今の気持ちを話してみる
records.en_original: ...I'm not sure how, but I'm going to try to tell her how I feel.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm not sure how it will go, but I'm going to try to tell her how I feel.
records.en: ...I don't know what will happen, but I'll try telling her how I feel.

records.jp: それでも仲直りできなかったら……仕方ない、かな
records.en_original: And if that doesn't help us make up, then...well, it might be a lost cause.
records.en_auxiliary: And if that doesn't help us make up, then...well, it might be a lost cause.
records.en: And if we still can't make up after that...then I guess it can't be helped.

records.jp: きっと大丈夫。しほりの気持ちは、届くと思うよ
records.en_original: It's going to be fine, Shihori. I think your feelings will make it through to her.
records.en_auxiliary: It's going to be fine, Shihori. I think your feelings will make it through to her.
records.en: It'll be okay. I think your feelings will reach her, Shihori.

records.jp: じゃあライムたちからはこれをあげる
records.en_original: Oh, and here's a little something from us.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, and here's a little something from us.
records.en: Then here's something from us.

records.jp: 指輪……？
records.en_original: A ring?
records.en_auxiliary: A ring?
records.en: A ring?

records.jp: みんなでお揃いにしてるの。<CR>ね、ヒナちゃん？
records.en_original: We all have one. Just ask Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: We all have one. Right, Hina?
records.en: We all have matching ones.<CR>Right, Hina-chan?

records.jp: う、うん。お守りになるかわからないけど、<CR>つけていてくれると嬉しい、かな……
records.en_original: Th-That's true. I can't vouch for it as a good luck charm, but it would make me happy if you wanted to wear it...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah. I can't vouch for it as a good luck charm, but it would make me happy if you wanted to wear it...
records.en: Y-Yeah. I don't know if it will bring you luck,<CR>but I would be happy if you wore it...

records.jp: あ、かわいい指輪だね！<CR>みんないいセンスしてるよ
records.en_original: Oh, it's so cute! You've all got such good taste.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, it's so cute! You've all got such good taste.
records.en: Oh, it is such a cute ring!<CR>You all have great taste.

records.jp: えへへー。そうかな？
records.en_original: Eheheh. You mean it?
records.en_auxiliary: Eheheh. You mean it?
records.en: Eheheh. You mean it?

records.jp: キレイ……
records.en_original: It's beautiful...
records.en_auxiliary: It's beautiful...
records.en: It's beautiful...

records.jp: これ、もらっていいの？
records.en_original: Are you sure I can have this?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you sure I can have this?
records.en: Are you sure I can have this?

records.jp: 化粧を教えてくれたお礼ってことで
records.en_original: After your makeup lesson, it's the least I can do.
records.en_auxiliary: After your makeup lesson, it's the least I can do.
records.en: Consider it thanks for teaching me about makeup.

records.jp: もらってくれないと困るしね
records.en_original: Honestly, we'd be disappointed if you didn't take it.
records.en_auxiliary: Honestly, we'd be disappointed if you didn't take it.
records.en: Besides, we'd be in trouble if you didn't take it.

records.jp: ありがとう。大事にするね
records.en_original: Thank you. That's so kind of you.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you. That's so kind of you.
records.en: Thank you. I'll treasure it.

records.jp: そうだ！　お礼に、次は服を見立ててあげる！
records.en_original: Oh, I know! As thanks for the ring, I'll help you refresh your entire wardrobe!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I know! As thanks for the ring, I'll help you refresh your entire wardrobe!
records.en: Oh, I know! To thank you, I'll pick out clothes for you next!

records.jp: え、これで終わりじゃないの？
records.en_original: Wait, we're not done with the makeover?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, we're not done with the makeover?
records.en: Wait, we're not done with the makeover?

records.jp: せっかくメイクするんだから、服もそれに合わせないと！ <CR>服を買ったら、次はアクセサリーだよ！
records.en_original: No way! It would be a shame not to have an outfit to go with the makeup! Oh, and we've got to buy accessories, too!
records.en_auxiliary: No way! It would be a shame not to have an outfit to go with the makeup! Oh, and we've got to buy accessories, too!
records.en: Since we're doing your makeup, your clothes have to match it!<CR>Once we buy clothes, accessories come next!

records.jp: それが終わったら髪もやらなきゃ！<CR>キレイ、に終わりはない……あくなき自分との戦いなんだから！
records.en_original: And after that, we'll do your hair! Beauty is an endless battle against yourself!
records.en_auxiliary: And after that, we'll do your hair! Beauty is an endless battle against yourself!
records.en: After that, we need to do your hair too!<CR>Beauty never ends... It's an endless battle against yourself!

records.jp: ……今日、帰れるのかな
records.en_original: ...I'm not getting home before midnight, am I?
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm not getting home before midnight, am I?
records.en: ...Will I even make it home today?
